## Privacy & Safety Checklist
- [ ] **NO REAL PII:** Verified that no real user screenshots, phone numbers, or private details are in test fixtures.
- [ ] **QUOTED EVIDENCE:** Any new rule extracts and quotes verbatim text.
- [ ] **NEVER SAYS SAFE:** Verified UI and messages do not state that a message is "safe".
- [ ] **TESTS PASS:** Backend tests passed (`cd backend && pytest`).
- [ ] **BUILD SUCCEEDS:** Frontend builds cleanly (`cd frontend && npm run build`).
